name: Martín Ezequiel Pulitano

bullets.text: GPA 9.64/10, top of class. High-school valedictorian. English C1.

Built Execution OS solo in 2 months: 30 mini apps, LLM pipelines, integrated accounting and an MCP server exposing the operation as agent-callable tools. Aiming to offload 80% of the manual work; in daily use and demoed to other executives.
Built an OCR and LLM pipeline turning image and PDF orders into structured data (Gemini with OpenAI fallback), cutting transcription errors 80–90% and halving token cost per order.
Shipped order-export integrations to distributor ERPs (Contabilium, Contagram).

Migrated legacy 4D systems to Java and Spring Boot for the second largest private bank in Argentina and an automotive lender, with an agentic testing pipeline in CI/CD that automated the conversion and cut manual effort roughly 40%.
Optimized Sybase stored procedures on critical financial paths.
Wrote COBOL Batch and Online programs on a core banking mainframe (CICS, JCL) under change control, production systems settling real transactions nightly. IBM Z Xplore certified.
On-device LLM gateway governing employee AI use: plain-language policies, secret masking, tamper-evident audit log. Signed macOS and Windows builds; launch in preparation.
Text-to-3D city reconstruction in Blender with a self-correcting render loop scored on held-out cameras. Seat-accurate stadiums from it are close to entering a first-division club's ticket flow.
Accounting automation for residential property managers. 5 paying clients, 50+ users, running unattended.
Panel of AI judges modeled on real experts scoring startup pitches; 500+ evaluated.
Arena where AI agents compete on coding bounties.
Choose-your-own-adventure game on a custom story engine; 5,000+ plays in a single week.

entries.title: The AI Collective, Buenos Aires chapter
entries.subtitle: Founder and Chapter Lead

bullets.text: Founded the chapter from nothing; first event drew 300 signups for a 30-seat room and ran with 100 in person and 100+ on stream.
Organizing the largest hackathon in the university's history. 12 hackathons entered, 9 podiums, 3 wins, judge at one.
Free AI bootcamp for high-school students, now in 30+ schools across five provinces. Built the platform and closed Banco Santander as sponsor.

items.label: Backend
items.text: Java, Spring Boot, Python, TypeScript, React, SQL, PostgreSQL, Sybase, Docker, AWS, COBOL.

items.label: AI
items.text: LLM agents, MCP servers, local inference, multi-model routing, LangChain, OCR pipelines, ML.

summary: Backend and AI engineer, three years shipping to production in banking, fintech and AI. Executive assistant to a unicorn co-founder, building his operating layer with agents. Won the Aleph hackathon against 151 projects with Warden, an on-device LLM gateway heading to launch.
